## Problem

Who encounters the problem, in which workflow, and what is blocked? Link related issues after searching existing requests. Explain the use case rather than only asking to support a named tool.

## Proposed change

Describe the smallest useful behavior, its scope, and explicit non-goals.

## Why this belongs in vange-workflow

How does it help fixed-role coordination, handoffs, evidence, or acceptance?

## Alternatives considered

Include existing capabilities, workarounds, and why they are insufficient.

## Impact on existing workflow contracts

Which ownership, canonical-source, review, state, or adapter contracts are affected? State explicitly if none are intended to change. A new CLI requires an adapter contract, not just an executable-name substitution.

## Security / permission considerations

Describe required permissions, data sent to external services, model verification, and potential irreversible actions. Do not include API keys, tokens, cookies, or unsanitized documents.

## Acceptance criteria

List observable outcomes and how they could be checked with synthetic inputs. Distinguish local/mock verification from any separately authorized real integration.
